_comment: Categories of suggested new variables that every pack gets (variable_categories.py). A pack adds its own, or replaces one of these by id, with "variable_categories" in its pack.json. value_type: number (one number with a unit; the column gets the unit's suffix and values are converted), text (words, at most max_words), any (a number if it is one, else short text). sources: where values come from without the model choosing (species, species:initial, species:sampled, added_solution); a category without sources (or with "model_assigns": true) is one the model can assign. Pack categories are listed first. Column order (column_order.py): a category's `columns` (by name) and `patterns` (regular expressions) say which dataset columns sit in its block, and `table_order` where the block goes (lower = further left); a pack adds columns to any category with "category_columns" in its pack.json. Columns nothing claims go in Other.

categories.label: Metadata
categories.description: about the study or its materials rather than one experiment's conditions: chemical suppliers and purities, sample or material origin, data or code availability

categories.label: Experimental Methodology
categories.description: how the experiment was set up and run, in words: apparatus, heating or mixing method, sealing, atmosphere handling, sterilisation, sampling procedure

categories.label: Other
categories.description: only when no other category fits: anything else worth recording
